sources.snippet: The Meta Llama 3.1 collection of multilingual large language models (LLMs) is a collection of pretrained and instruction tuned generative models. The Llama 3.1 instruction tuned text only models are optimized for multilingual dialogue use cases and outperform many of the available open source and closed chat models on common industry benchmarks.

sources.snippet: Overview Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct is a multilingual instruction-tuned language model developed by meta-llama with 8 billion parameters, released July 23, 2024. The model uses an optimized transformer architecture with grouped-query attention (GQA) for efficient inference, trained on approximately 15 trillion tokens of publicly available data with a knowledge cutoff of December 2023.
